newsitem.title: USA: Golden Poultry board accepts $14.25/shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Golden Poultry board accepts $14.25/shr offer.

text.p: The Golden Poultry Co Inc said Tuesday its board of directors has accepted an offer from Gold Kist Inc, an agricultural cooperative, to purchase the Golden Poultry shares it does not presently own for $14.25 per share.
The shares were trading at $13.25 mid-Tuesday afternoon.
Gold Kist owns about 10.9 million, or 75 percent, of Golden Poultry's 14.6 million outstanding shares of common stock.
The purchase is subject to approval of a definitive agreement by the Gold Kist directors and by Golden Poultry shareholders other than Gold Kist.
Golden Poultry had fiscal 1996 sales of about $600 million. Gold Kist, also based in Atlanta, serves approximately 30,000 members and has fiscal 1996 sales of about $2 billion.
